theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_ie_fderiv_apply_harmonic
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (e : Euclid n), IsOpen U → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m h U) → (∀ y ∈ U, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y e) U) ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun z => fderiv ℝ h z e) y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
